feature: Social Story overlay moderation and upload ordering

pre_fix_failure_first.observed: Failed as expected: blocked and approved story cases each expected one moderation request but received zero; the creator sent the story without a moderation request.
Failed as expected: flagged overlay text did not throw CONTENT_MODERATION_FAILED or stop story creation.

implementation: StoryCreator combines nonblank TEXT overlays and requires a successful moderation envelope with action approve before sticker upload or story submission.
StoryServiceImpl independently moderates TEXT overlays and fails closed for null, flag, block, or unknown results.
StoryController passes the background multipart file into the service; the service validates the optional public recipe and moderation result before uploading the background image.

full_e2e.expected_skips: Two live graph cases because localhost:8080 was unavailable; two mutually exclusive Explorer-off cases; two mutually exclusive research-off cases.

frontend.production_build: PASS with Graph Explorer, Graph Evidence, and research flags enabled

verified_behavior: Flag, block, unknown action, missing action, and moderation-service failure do not submit a story and preserve overlay text for correction.
Explicit approval permits story submission on desktop and iPhone-sized Chromium.
Stories without text overlays publish without a moderation request.
Backend non-approval stops the story before background upload and repository persistence.
A linked private or missing recipe is rejected before background upload.
limitations: The browser intercepts APIs with local fixtures; no live FE-to-Monolith story transaction or Mongo persistence was exercised.
Backend tests use Mockito; real Cloudinary/background or sticker upload and production moderation were not exercised.
The full browser run skipped the live graph cases because the Monolith was not listening on localhost:8080.
